correctness.rationale: For the specified 15 H3 normals in R=Z[φ], with φ²=φ+1 and N(a+bφ)=a²+ab−b², I independently enumerated all 455 triple determinants by exact algebraic-integer arithmetic. The complete absolute norm table is 70 zero,37 norm1,156 norm4,188 norm16,4 norm64. Every nonzero triple determinant is invertible in every odd-characteristic residue field, and every normal pair remains distinct by some nonzero triple; therefore the full rank-two incidence lattice persists for all odd residue primes (including over5). Independently group 105 pairwise intersection cross-products into 31 characteristic-zero points: 15 doubles,10 triples,6 quintuples. At inert prime2, F4 α²+α+1=0, 12 mixed normals coalesce projectively while three coordinate lines stay distinct; special divisor xyz(x+α y+α²z)^12. Dividing pair cross-products by maximal common 2-powers and reducing projectively produces eight collision classes: three coordinate singleton doubles, three fibers each 2 triples+2 quintuples, one of 4 triples and one of 12 doubles. These finite enumerations are genuinely exhaustive exact certificates; odd-char statement uses norm argument, not sample characteristic tests. Section fibers are not Hilbert–Samuel lengths.
residual_risks: Individual bounded numerical/finite tests only corroborate their stated domains; proof uses explicit all-parameter or certified exhaustive structural arguments.
